nodes.skradanie_ok.text.t: Before they can work out what happened, you're round the corner, and your purse is still lying politely where you left it.

nodes.skradanie_pudlo.text.t: One of the lads sticks out a foot and you go sprawling on the cobbles. "Oooh, clumsy!" he calls, a knife flashing in his hand. "You won't get far like that, mister."

nodes.ucieczka.text.t: "Oho, a coward!" the boy calls, but he doesn't chase. It's not worth running after someone who runs that fast.

nodes.walka.text.t: The boy sighs like a man interrupted at supper. A knife flashes in his sleeve.

nodes.wybor.options.[skradanie].text.t: I turn away as if I'd noticed nothing and slip past them.

nodes.wybor.options.[ucieczka].text.t: I'd rather not risk it. I back off.

nodes.wybor.options.[walka].text.t: Give back what you took, and quick.

nodes.wybor.options.[wymowa].text.t: Lads, I was a sharp one once too. Not with me.

nodes.wybor.text.t: "Oh, mister, my mistake. A small one, an innocent one." The boy is holding something that was yours a moment ago. "We can settle this or we can brawl. Makes no difference to me, as long as it's quick."

nodes.wymowa_ok.text.t: "All right, all right, you've got a tongue on you. Such a worldly gentleman, it'd be a shame to rob you." The lads vanish into the crowd, leaving you a purse you hadn't yet got round to losing.

nodes.wymowa_pudlo.text.t: "You talk like a clerk, but you smell like a man with more in his pockets than he lets on." The boy grins, and a knife flashes in his sleeve. "Enough of the nice talk, mister. Now we'll talk my way."
